arStrings.szText:
{c_label}Cooldown:{/c_label} {c_resource}{Cooldown Time}{/c_resource} seconds
Summon {c_number}[SF_53]{/c} Ancients to aid you in battle for {c_number}{SF_0}{/c} seconds.
{icon:bullet, 1.2} {c_label}Korlic{/c} leaps at enemies, dealing {c_number}{payload:LEAP_TOOLTIP}{/c} damage and swings his weapons in a frenzy, dealing {c_number}{payload:FRENZY_TOOLTIP}{/c} damage per hit.
{icon:bullet, 1.2} {c_label}Talic{/c} spins in a whirlwind rapidly attacking enemies for {c_number}{payload:WHIRLWIND_TOOLTIP}{/c} damage.
{icon:bullet, 1.2} {c_label}Madawc{/c} upheaves the ground, dealing {c_number}{payload:UPHEAVAL_TOOLTIP}{/c} damage.
Ultimate: Call upon the Ancients to annihilate your enemies.

Your Ancients are empowered:
{icon:bullet}Korlic creates an {c_important}Earthquake{/c} that deals {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEA_EARTHQUAKE_PAYLOAD}{/c} Physical damage over {c_number}[PowerTag.Barbarian_Earthquake."Script Formula 1"]{/c} seconds when he leaps.
{icon:bullet}Talic leaves behind {c_important}Dust Devils{/c} that deal {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEA_DUSTDEVIL_DMG_TOOLTIP}{/c} damage while he whirlwinds.
{icon:bullet}Madawc ignites the earth, Burning enemies for an additional {c_number}{dot:UPGRADE_A_UPHEAVAL_FIRE_DOT}{/c} damage over {c_number}{SF_48}{/c} seconds when he upheaves the ground.

Depending on your last used weapon, you summon {c_number}[SF_54]{/c} very strong {if:SF_42}Ancients{else}Ancient{/if} for twice as long.

Your Ancient gains an additional power:
{c_label}Korlic:{/c} You gain {c_number}10{/c} Fury each time Korlic damages an enemy with his {c_important}Frenzy{/c}.
{c_label}Talic:{/c} Enemies are Slowed by {c_number}[{SF_16}*100|%|]{/c} for {c_number}{SF_17}{/c} second when damaged by his {c_important}Whirlwind{/c}.
{c_label}Madawc:{/c} {c_number}[{SF_18}*100|%|]{/c} chance to Stun enemies for {c_number}{SF_19}{/c} seconds when using his {c_important}Upheaval{/c}.
Summon a single, permanent Ancient. Using this skill again replaces it with the next Ancient.

When you Cast {c_important}Call of the Ancients{/c}, gain {c_number}[SF_38 * 100|+%|]{/c} Attack Speed and {c_number}[SF_39 * 100|%x|]{/c} increased damage for each Ancient summoned for {c_number}{buffduration:UPGRADE2_ATTACKSPEED_DAMAGE}{/c} seconds.
You and each of your Ancients summoned from this Skill increase each other's damage by {c_number}[SF_41 *100|%x|]{/c}.
When you Cast {c_important}Call of the Ancients{/c}, gain {c_number}[SF_45 * 100|%|]{/c} Damage Reduction for each Ancient summoned while they are active.
